import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get species order and IDs for submission
submission_cols = sample_submission.columns.tolist()
submission_col_ids = submission_cols[1:]  # Skip 'id'
species_names = submission_col_ids

# Define feature columns (all except id and species in train)
train_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
test_cols = [col for col in test_df.columns if col not in ["id"]]

# Extract features and target
X_train = train_df[train_cols].values
y_train = train_df["species"].values
X_test = test_df[test_cols].values

# Create hold-out validation split
# Using 80% train, 20% val for validation metric
X_train_sub, X_val, y_train_sub, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train model
model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
model.fit(X_train_sub, y_train_sub)

# Predict on validation
val_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
# Clip probabilities to avoid log(0)
eps = 1e-15
val_proba_clipped = np.clip(val_proba, eps, 1 - eps)

# Calculate log loss formula: - (1/N) sum_i sum_j y_ij log(p_ij)
# One-hot encode validation labels for calculation
val_onehot = np.zeros((len(y_val), len(species_names)))
val_onehot[
    np.arange(len(y_val)), [species_names.index(species) for species in y_val]
] = 1.0

logloss_val = -np.mean(np.sum(val_onehot * np.log(val_proba_clipped), axis=1))
print(f"Validation LogLoss: {logloss_val}")

# Predict on test
test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)
test_proba_clipped = np.clip(test_proba, eps, 1 - eps)

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_proba, columns=species_names)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"])
submission_df = submission_df[submission_cols]

# Save submission
import os

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
